name: Vector balls
description: A corridor of shaded spheres flying past the camera — the Amiga sprite trick, but framed as a flight down a stack of rings instead of one formation in the middle of the frame. Near balls fill the corners, far ones converge on a vanishing point.

rings.description: How far down the corridor the stack reaches. More rings is more depth and more cost.

radius.description: Ball size in world units. Large enough that the nearest ring overruns the frame.

spread.description: Ring radius. Above ~1.2 the ring passes outside the frame edges and the corridor reads as a wall of balls.

speed.description: How fast the stack comes at the camera.

twist.description: Per-ring rotation offset. Turns the stack into a corkscrew.

haze.description: Glow down the throat of the corridor.
